Title: Clarify scope and mandatory requirements
Acceptance criteria: Record aim, scope and Must requirements; team reviews wording.

Title: Conduct 3-5 user discussions
Acceptance criteria: Record consent, anonymised notes, findings and links to requirement changes.

Title: Verify the full-text scientific review
Acceptance criteria: Use at least 12 sources, including 8 scientific works; provide limitations and accurate references.

Title: Agree technologies and API
Acceptance criteria: Compare technology alternatives; team reviews the contract and error model.

Title: Verify the comparison of 4 systems
Acceptance criteria: Use 8 criteria; cite evidence, mark unknown features and avoid unsupported advantages.

Title: Review requirements and architecture
Acceptance criteria: Align three diagrams, editable sources and exports with requirements.

Title: Review UX and RU/KZ wording
Acceptance criteria: Cover main and error flows; a Kazakh speaker reviews Kazakh text.

Title: Approve data and evaluation protocol
Acceptance criteria: Document annotation, grouped splits, baselines, metrics and measurement conditions.

Title: Obtain substantive supervisor feedback
Acceptance criteria: Record actual comments and link decisions and changes to versions.

Title: Set up repository and task board
Acceptance criteria: Verify both accounts, roles, tasks, criteria, access and links.

Title: Document each member's contribution
Acceptance criteria: Each member reviews their materials and makes genuine changes under their own account; review is visible.

Title: Assemble final PDF and board screenshots
Acceptance criteria: Verify commission access; combine actual screenshots; align the report with the prob-period-1 tag.

Title: Implement B0 and a basic test corpus
Acceptance criteria: Provide deterministic rules, unit tests and documented limitations.

Title: Build API and opt-in history
Acceptance criteria: Implement validation, history authorisation, deletion and integration tests.

Title: Compare B0 B1 B2 on the local corpus
Acceptance criteria: Use a fixed split; report language metrics, confidence intervals, latency and an honest conclusion.
